**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

The source calls this a GIF, but the unchanged downloadable output is animated WebP: nine frames, 200 ms each, 1.8 seconds, looping. All nine frames and the separate AI-generated reference were inspected. The public detail-page prompt was checked. The creator claims GPT Image 2.6; this example has no established Flare/Sunburst variant. Offline recovery review on 2026-11-08 rechecked retained source evidence and original file integrity. Current source availability, animation playback and model execution were not tested.
